meaning:
ῥυπαρός, -ά, -όν
(ῥύπος), [in LXX: Zec.3:4-5, (3-4) (צוֹא)* ;]
filthy, dirty: of old, shabby clothing (Za, l.with), Jas.2:2; metaphorically, of moral defilement, Rev.22:11.†
(AS)
